item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 9:20 PM, 12 October 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (San Juan, Lobo, Batangas City, Taysan, Ibaan, Padre Garcia, and Rosario), Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad and Norzagaray), Nueva Ecija (Cuyapo, Pantabangan, Bongabon, Rizal, Carranglan, Gabaldon, General Tinio, Guimba, Licab, Quezon, Nampicuan, Talugtug, Laur, San Antonio, and Zaragoza), Quezon (General Nakar, Infanta, Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Perez, Unisan, Gumaca, Pitogo, Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Real, Sampaloc, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Patnanungan, and San Narciso), Tarlac (San Manuel, Victoria, Pura, Gerona, Ramos, Anao, Moncada, Paniqui, La Paz, Tarlac City, and Concepcion), and Zambales (Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc, Palauig, Iba, Botolan, Cabangan, San Felipe, and San Marcelino) within the next 2 hours.

Heavy to intense rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are affecting Quezon (Tagkawayan, Alabat, Quezon, Plaridel, Atimonan, Pagbilao, Padre Burgos, Agdangan, San Francisco, and San Andres) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
